dominant_strengths: Information is densely structured with clear markdown hierarchy, making product capabilities scannable for technical or evaluator audiences.
Consistent monospace rendering produces a uniform rhythm and predictable indentation across all six product sections.
dominant_weaknesses: This is raw markdown source on a terminal background, not a designed artifact—zero visual hierarchy beyond ASCII headings.
Single-weight green-on-black monospace ignores Ramp's brand system; no color, spacing, imagery, or component design exists.
Long unwrapped lines overflow horizontally, breaking readability and signaling absence of any layout or responsive thinking.
fix_priorities: Render the markdown into an actual styled page with typographic scale, brand palette, and proper line-length constraints.
Introduce sectional cards or anchored navigation so the six product areas become visually distinct modules.
Add supporting visuals—iconography, screenshots, or data callouts—to make 'use cases' viscerally tangible rather than textual.
Establish a Ramp-native color system (off-white, sharp accent) replacing the default terminal aesthetic.
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral content is decent but visceral and reflective layers are absent because nothing has been visually designed.
rationale.intent_fit: Fails the fintech brief—this is unrendered source text, not a Ramp-styled product surface.
